text.arabic_uthmani: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۢ

words.gloss_range: possessive and exclusive preposition fronted before the dominion noun
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens with possession already in force: the relation to the divine name is heard before the dominion noun arrives. That fronting makes the clause exclusive, so the reader hears belonging-to-Allāh as the frame for the entire ayah, while the fused lām sound adds recitational pressure without becoming a separate lexical claim.

topics.headline: fronted possessive relation creates exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts from belonging and restriction before naming what is owned.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the preposition as governing the divine name and fronted before the subject, supporting possessive restriction.

topics.headline: proclitic fusion makes dependency audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the possession marker as attached and audible, while its sound does not add an independent meaning beyond the syntax.
topics.reason: The surface form is a proclitic and the recited lām cluster supports acoustic binding, but grammar remains the controlling evidence.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed by the possessive preposition and anchoring both clauses
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, refuge, and dependence; locally the proper divine name in a governed possessor slot selects the named divine referent
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) supplies the named possessor in the opening restriction. The proper name fixes the referent for the later pronoun, so the second clause does not introduce a new subject. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) field adds worship, refuge, and bewildered dependence as a narrowed pressure around the name: dominion is assigned to the worship-directed one before whom need turns, not merely to a generic sovereign. The same-surah return of the li-llāhi mulk formula (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120) makes the final ayah a summative sovereignty declaration, shifting from Allāh as judgment speaker and satisfier in 5:119 to Allāh as cosmic owner in 5:120.

topics.headline: proper name anchors possessor and later pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named divine possessor governs the first clause and remains the referent of the second.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a proper noun governed by the preceding preposition, and attachment evidence links it to the predication of dominion.

topics.headline: worship and dependence pressure around the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ownership claim is relational as well as juridical, while local grammar keeps the word functioning as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: V4 and supplied lexical evidence license worship, refuge, and dependence around the divine-name field, but the local surface selects the proper noun rather than a common-noun derivation.

topics.headline: same-surah formula return (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this final naming gathers earlier sovereignty declarations into the surah close.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply the same-surah formula references, and the local words reproduce the ownership frame at the endpoint.

topics.headline: assimilated lām cluster compresses the opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact recited opening, while sound remains a supporting texture rather than the basis of the claim.
topics.reason: The surface and recitation support lām assimilation, but the possession reading is established by syntax.

words.gloss_range: stable dominion, sovereignty, and dispositional authority in construct with the cosmic domain
words.root_gloss_range: ownership, sovereignty, kingship, and power to dispose; locally selected as stable dominion over the cosmic domain
words.prose: {{ar:مُلْكُ}} ({{tr:mulku}}) is the abstract subject whose dominion is assigned to Allāh by the advanced predicate. Its construct form binds sovereignty directly to the heavens-earth domain, so the noun is not a detached title. The {{ar:م ل ك}} ({{tr:m-l-k}}) field gives the word ownership, kingship, ordered administration, and power-to-dispose pressure; references to related administrative or variant forms are narrowed to support the stable local sense. Its return in the sovereignty formula (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120) launches the ayah's movement from ownership to scope and then to power, contrasting earlier limited created ownership with the final assignment of the whole dominion to Allāh.

topics.headline: construct subject binds dominion to cosmic scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dominion is a standing noun tied immediately to its governed domain, not a time-bound act of owning.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as the nominative subject and construct head governing the following genitive domain.

topics.headline: ownership, kingship, and ordered control converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dominion means authority with disposal, while non-surface derivatives only color the local noun.
topics.reason: V4 supports the m-l-k field of ownership and sovereignty; derivative references such as angelic administration are retained only as root-family pressure.

topics.headline: sovereignty formula return and closing progression (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word both recalls earlier sovereignty claims and starts the closing expansion from dominion to universal capability.
topics.reason: Contextual rows supply same-surah references and the local syntax confirms the progression from dominion to domains, contents, and power.

topics.headline: variant sound pressure leaves dominion intact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational pressure point without losing the stable sovereignty reading.
topics.reason: The variant affects vocalic and sound texture, while QAC alignment and local syntax preserve the noun as the same subject of dominion.

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper realms, grammatically governed as the first cosmic domain
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, sky, and upper realm; locally plural definite heavens form the elevated pole of the cosmic pair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:as-samāwāti}}) gives the first governed domain under dominion: definite, plural, and elevated. The {{ar:س م و}} ({{tr:s-m-w}}) field contributes height, canopy, and upper-realm pressure, so the later contents phrase can feel housed within elevated domains rather than merely listed after them. The plural form supports layered upper domains without forcing a separate count. The word also anchors the feminine plural reference in the contents phrase, and its pairing with earth forms the upper-lower merism returned in the surah's sovereignty statements (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120).

topics.headline: definite plural heavens govern later agreement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the upper domain is both governed by dominion and grammatically active in the later pronoun.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive under the construct, and attachment/referent evidence licenses the feminine plural agreement.

topics.headline: elevation and layered upper-realm pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the vertical upper pole of the cosmic map, while the plural does not by itself require a detailed cosmology here.
topics.reason: V4 and supplied semantics support height, canopy, and plural upper realms; local prose keeps that pressure tied to the merism.

topics.headline: heavens-earth formula return (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the upper domain begins a known totality pair rather than an isolated sky reference.
topics.reason: The same-surah references and attachment coordination support reading the word with earth as a meristic domain under dominion.

topics.headline: assimilated article smooths the upper-domain expression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recited smoothness of the definite plural, while the syntactic domain claim remains primary.
topics.reason: The sun-letter assimilation is a surface-recitation feature and does not independently change scope.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that gives earth equal rank with the heavens in the merism
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the joint that gives earth equal grammatical rank with the heavens. It builds the upper-lower merism instead of letting the second domain trail as an afterthought, and its attached surface carries the listener into the second pole.

topics.headline: coordination gives the two domains equal rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that total spatial scope is built by a conjunction, not inferred after the fact.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the particle as coordination between the heavens and earth under the same construct.

topics.headline: liaison carries recitation into the second pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible continuation into the earth phrase, while sound only reinforces the coordination already present.
topics.reason: The recitational liaison supports continuity, but the merism is established by syntactic coordination.

words.gloss_range: definite singular terrestrial domain conjoined under the same dominion claim
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, and spread substrate; locally the definite singular names the terrestrial pole under the same dominion
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) completes the lower pole of the heavens-earth pair. Its genitive case is inherited through coordination, so earth is governed by the same dominion rather than starting a new clause. The {{ar:أ ر ض}} ({{tr:ʾ-r-ḍ}}) field gives low, spread, material-substrate pressure, and the definite singular makes the terrestrial domain whole rather than a local plot. The same-surah returns (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120) make this closing earth reference part of the repeated sovereignty frame.

topics.headline: definite singular earth shares the genitive governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is included under the same construct relation and treated as one comprehensive terrestrial domain.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show earth conjoined to the heavens and sharing genitive governance under dominion.

topics.headline: low spread substrate grounds the claim materially
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cosmic dominion includes the grounded material plane, while the local reference remains the definite earth in the merism.
topics.reason: V4 and supplied semantics support ground, land, and substrate pressure; local syntax selects the terrestrial pole.

topics.headline: lower pole completes formula return (5:17, 5:18, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase becomes total spatial dominion only when the earth completes the pair.
topics.reason: Contextual rows and attachment coordination support the heavens-earth pair as a recurring sovereignty formula.

topics.headline: emphatic consonant gives the lower pole weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sound texture matching the grounded domain, while it remains secondary to grammar and semantics.
topics.reason: The sound observation is preserved as recitational texture, not as independent semantic evidence.

words.gloss_range: additive conjunction extending the dominion list from domains to contents
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) expands the dominion list beyond the two named containers. It keeps the following relative phrase attached to the ownership claim, so the ayah moves from cosmic domains to whatever they contain. Compared with the earlier between-language noted for 5:17, this final wording emphasizes interior containment in 5:120.

topics.headline: coordination pivots from domains to contents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dominion covers not only the containers but also the contents inside them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the relative phrase with the preceding domain list, preserving it inside the dominion claim.

topics.headline: changed reprise from between-language to inside-language (5:17, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sovereignty reprise broadens through interior containment rather than only between-space.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the 5:17 comparison, and local syntax supports the final phrase as a scope expansion.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun meaning whatever or that which, not negation in this context
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is a relative pronoun here, not a negator or question particle. It creates an open but referential contents class: whatever is inside the domains belongs within the dominion claim. The short form compresses beings, processes, and states without listing them.

topics.headline: relative pronoun creates the contents class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word includes what is inside the domains instead of negating or asking anything.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly corrects the contextual value to a relative pronoun, and attachment evidence makes the following prepositional phrase its predicate.

topics.headline: open reference compresses contained existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse avoids enumeration while still bringing all contained entities, processes, and states into scope.
topics.reason: The relative construction is short but semantically broad, and nothing in the guardrail evidence narrows it to a listed subset.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine plural suffix marking what is within the named domains
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) completes the relative clause by locating the open contents inside the named domains. Its suffix is feminine plural, agreeing most directly with the heavens while pragmatically carrying the whole heavens-earth domain. The phrase shifts from mere location toward contained existence, and its inside-language differs from the earlier between-them counterpart by emphasizing contents within the cosmic enclosure rather than only interspace. It prepares the later contrast with power over every thing.

topics.headline: preposition plus suffix completes contained reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contents are not free-floating; they are defined as what is inside the already named domains.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase as the predicate of the relative pronoun, with the suffix routed back to the domain phrase.

topics.headline: interiority suggests existential containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inside-ness carries dependence within the claimed domain, while the local grammar remains a prepositional predicate.
topics.reason: Lexical semantics allow broader interiority, but the syntactic role is the controlling local evidence.

topics.headline: nasal closure tightens the enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible closure on the containment phrase, while sound does not determine the pronoun reference.
topics.reason: The sound row is retained as recitational texture secondary to agreement and attachment.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a second nominal sentence about capability
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) begins the second nominal sentence. It links the ownership declaration to the capability declaration while preserving the boundary between them; resumption is the primary local function, and any circumstantial pressure serves that same ownership-to-power turn.

topics.headline: resumptive pivot from ownership to power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely add another possessed item; it opens a fresh declaration about capability.
topics.reason: QAC marks the conjunction as resumption, and the independent pronoun after it confirms a new nominal sentence; circumstantial readings remain compatible pressure rather than the main parse.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun that resumes the named divine referent as the subject of the power clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) resumes the divine referent as an independent subject. Its detached form prevents the power clause from being swallowed as a modifier of dominion, and it makes the owner of the first clause the same subject of the final capability predicate. A pronoun-of-matter reading is possible as a formal pressure, but the local reference to the named possessor is the controlling link.

topics.headline: detached pronoun launches the power clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second clause has its own subject while staying linked to the named possessor.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the pronoun as the subject of the second nominal sentence whose predicate is the final adjective.

topics.headline: formal declaration pressure without losing reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a heightened declarative feel, while the local anaphoric reference remains to the named divine possessor.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row allows a pronoun-of-matter reading as pressure, but cross-reference evidence keeps the ordinary referential route active.

topics.headline: focus contracts from rewarded humans to the singular divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from the plural human scene of 5:119 to the singular divine subject of 5:120.
topics.reason: The boundary row provides the 5:119 contrast, and the local pronoun supplies the singular subject of the new declaration.

words.gloss_range: scope preposition marking jurisdictional power over the following universal phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) sets the scope of the power predicate. It governs the universal phrase that follows, so the relation is jurisdictional coverage rather than physical placement. Its over-ness remains as an image of authority, and its position before the final adjective lets the listener hear the extent before the predicate lands.

topics.headline: preposition marks jurisdictional scope before the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that power is stated with an explicit domain of coverage before the final attribute arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the preposition as governing the following universal phrase as the scope complement of the predicate adjective.

topics.headline: spatial over-ness narrows to authority scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an authority image behind the scope marker, while the local sense is not spatial location.
topics.reason: Lexical range includes on and over, but QAC and translation support require jurisdictional scope in this clause.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct universal quantifier making the scope exceptionless
words.root_gloss_range: whole, each, every, and all; locally a genitive construct quantifier distributing power over every individual thing
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) is the quantifier that turns the closing tail into an exceptionless claim. As a genitive construct head, it depends on the following indefinite singular noun and distributes the predicate over every individual item, not vague allness. Its same-surah return in the power formula (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:120) makes the final clause a closing reprise of total capability.

topics.headline: construct quantifier distributes over every individual thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is built grammatically by construct relation and indefiniteness, not by loose emphasis.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a genitive construct quantifier governed by the preposition and governing the following noun.

topics.headline: power formula return (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quantifier bridges the dominion claim to the final universal power refrain.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply the formula references, and the local clause places the quantifier between the scope preposition and final predicate.

topics.headline: geminated lām compresses totality audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact sound of the totalizing word, while grammar carries the universal force.
topics.reason: The sound observation is retained as texture supporting a quantifier whose scope is established syntactically.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular thing/entity under the total quantifier, the object-domain of power
words.root_gloss_range: thing, entity, existent, or identifiable unit; locally an indefinite singular complement that opens universal scope
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) supplies the object-domain for the universal power claim. Its genitive relation to the quantifier and its indefinite tanwīn open the phrase to any identifiable entity, while the singular form distributes scope item by item. The {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) field can press toward existent and will-related thingness, but locally the word functions as the broad noun that gives the final predicate explicit scope. Its return with the power formula (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:117, 5:120) carries the surah's totality language into the close.

topics.headline: indefinite singular complement opens the object-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every thing means each possible identifiable entity, not a named subset.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as the genitive complement of the quantifier, with indefiniteness producing universal scope.

topics.headline: existent and will-related thingness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that thingness reaches beyond physical objects toward any existent, while derivational will-language remains a supporting pressure.
topics.reason: V4 and supplied lexical evidence support existent and will-family associations, but local syntax selects the broad noun inside the universal formula.

topics.headline: totality formula return (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:117, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this noun gives the recurring power formula its explicit universal object-domain at the surah close.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide same-surah references, and the local phrase places the noun between the total quantifier and final predicate.

topics.headline: hamza marks a discrete stop in the noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small sound stop matching the discrete-unit function, while the universal reading comes from grammar.
topics.reason: The phonetic row survives as recitational texture secondary to construct grammar and indefiniteness.

words.gloss_range: nominative qualitative predicate on the faʿīl pattern, sealing the ayah with enduring capability
words.root_gloss_range: power, ability, measure, determining, and decree; locally stable capability over every thing with measured comprehensiveness
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:qadīrun}}) is the nominative predicate of the second nominal sentence, not an adjective attached to the preceding noun. Its faʿīl pattern and tanwīn present capability as an enduring quality, and the {{ar:ق د ر}} ({{tr:q-d-r}}) field adds measured determination to power without turning the word into a measurement noun. As the final word, it seals the surah's repeated formula (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:120): ownership, domains, contents, and universal scope end in comprehensive capability. That final seal also answers the capability pressure raised in 5:112 and gathers the earlier power formulas into the surah's last asserted attribute.

topics.headline: nominative faʿīl predicate seals the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word describes the divine subject, not every powerful thing in the object-domain.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as the nominative predicate of the independent pronoun, while form rows support the qualitative faʿīl reading.

topics.headline: power and measure converge as calibrated capability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that capability is exact and determining, while non-surface measurement forms only sharpen the local adjective.
topics.reason: V4 supports q-d-r links among power, measure, decree, and determining; local morphology selects the qualitative adjective.

topics.headline: final power seal and formula return (5:17, 5:19, 5:40, 5:120)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah ends by gathering earlier power assertions into a final attribute, not by returning to narrative detail.
topics.reason: Contextual rows supply the repeated formula and final-word position, and attachment evidence links the universal scope phrase to the predicate.

topics.headline: firm sound texture supports measured power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices acoustic firmness at the close, while the theological claim rests on morphology, syntax, and formula recurrence.
topics.reason: The sound rows are retained as texture and do not govern the parse or root sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted assignment to God, mulk, the heavens/earth merism, what is in them, and the closing construction over every thing as qadir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening possessive assigns the whole vertical domain to one owner. Mulk supplies sovereign disposal, the upper/lower pair plus their contents closes spatial gaps, every reportable thing closes categorical gaps, and qadir makes the title effective rather than nominal.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one is the sole recipient of the fronted possessive, making the sovereignty claim cultically exclusive.
Kingship and sovereignty provide the governing title for the entire mechanism.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper extent of the owned domain.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the domain's complementary lower extent.
Encompassing totality prevents any class of entity from falling outside the claim.
The most general knowable and reportable entity turns totality into coverage of each particular.
Effective capacity, command, and possession make universal title executable.

changed_reading.before: God owns the cosmos and is generally powerful.
changed_reading.after: The ayah closes every spatial and categorical escape from God's exclusive, effective jurisdiction: no occupant or thing has an autonomous domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mulk and qadir read through their cohesion, mainstay, measure, and considered-order branches, with kull shay identifying the differentiated totality held by them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mulk can image the force that keeps a structure coherent and the mainstay on which an affair depends, while qadr can image both a thing's fitted amount and deliberative arrangement. Joined to every knowable particular, sovereignty becomes the holding and calibration of an articulated order, not only legal title over a mass.

activation_trace.role: Strength and cohesion recast dominion as what keeps a structured whole from coming apart.
The mainstay of an affair gives sovereignty an infrastructural rather than merely titular role.
Encompassing totality supplies the complete system whose parts are held together.
Each knowable particular keeps the model differentiated rather than reducing it to undivided totality.
A quantity, bound, or appointed measure supplies calibration for each thing.
Considered arrangement and preparation supply the ordering operation behind that calibration.

changed_reading.before: Mulk is ownership and qadir is unrestricted force.
changed_reading.after: Mulk is also the cohesion and mainstay of the whole, while qadir is the competence that fits and arranges every distinct thing within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal sequence repeatedly translates a breach into a measured substitute: median household food or fixed fasting, then a like animal or assessed equivalent. These operations activate qadr's amount and deliberative-order branches inside mulk's power of disposal, so universal capacity appears as competence to fit consequence to case.

activation_trace.role: Ownership with authority to dispose supplies the jurisdiction within which remedies are assigned.
A fitted amount or bound receives concrete support from quantified and equivalent remedies.
Deliberative measurement supplies the operative mode behind case-sensitive substitution.
A middle rank between better and worse makes ordinary household provision the calibrated reference point.
Reciprocal recompense turns an act into an answer proportioned to it.
Likeness supplies the explicit matching relation between loss and replacement.
Judgment between people turns proportion from private guesswork into an assessed disposition.
Equivalence links the just assessors and the alternative value within one balancing procedure.

structural_cues: 5:89 offers ordered substitutes keyed to ordinary provision and ability.
5:95 repeats recompense, likeness, adjudication, and equivalence inside one restoration procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graded and equivalent substitutions; I supply the arrow from those procedures to qadr as a mode of sovereign action. A live alternative is that qadir in 5:120 denotes unrestricted ability without carrying the legal proportionality forward.

changed_reading.before: Being qadir over every thing means being able to overpower any object.
changed_reading.after: Being qadir also means possessing the sovereign competence to assign a fitting measure, limit, or restorative equivalent to each particular case.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 5:97 God first makes a social-sacral institution a qiyam for people and then names knowledge of almost the same cosmic scope as 5:120. The closing addition of mulk and qadir activates mulk's mainstay branch: the domain God knows is also the domain He can establish, hold up, and govern.

activation_trace.role: The mainstay on which an affair depends turns cosmic dominion into sustaining governance.
Effective capacity converts the known cosmic scope into a scope that can be established and maintained.
Making something assume a state supplies the concrete act by which a support-order is instituted.
Qiwam as mainstay and livelihood gives the made institution its social sustaining function.
Three knowledge occurrences frame the earlier cosmic formula as a domain wholly disclosed to God.
The same upper domain begins the close lexical echo.
The same lower counterpart completes the echoed cosmic merism.
Encompassing totality reproduces the universal scope later governed by mulk.
Every knowable particular completes the near-verbatim bridge to 5:120.

structural_cues: 5:97 joins a made qiyam for people to God's knowledge of the heavens, earth, and every thing.
5:120 repeats that cosmic scope, adds what is within it, and replaces the knowledge predicate with mulk plus qadir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies qiyam and the close lexical echo; I infer that 5:120 moves from total knowledge to the capacity that establishes and sustains the known order. A live alternative is that qiyam concerns only the sanctuary and the repeated cosmic formula is conventional rather than mechanistically linked.

changed_reading.before: The final dominion formula is detached from the pericope's social institutions.
changed_reading.after: The formula scales the earlier qiyam upward: God's mulk is the mainstay-capacity by which the entire known cosmic and social order can stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet does not erase Jesus's extraordinary acts; it places forming, animating, healing, and bringing forth under repeated permission, then raises the question of ability and rejects converting an empowered servant into a deity. This revises universal ownership into a framework that can license real subordinate agency while reserving its source, title, and limit to God.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal provide the superior title under which another agent may receive limited use.
Sovereignty preserves the hierarchy between licensed action and independent rule.
Every entity includes empowered agents and their effects within the owned field.
Originary effective capacity supplies and bounds derivative capacity.
The context grants a genuinely creation-like act to the subordinate agent rather than reducing it to empty appearance.
Fourfold permission marks forming, animation, healing, and bringing forth as licensed effects.
The explicit question of ability primes the later qadir predicate and locates ability with the Lord.
The charge of taking two worshipped beings apart from God exposes the forbidden conversion of delegated agency into divine title.
Shared lordship over speaker and audience restores one sovereignty above both.
Servitude under ownership places even the disputed community inside God's title.

structural_cues: 5:110 repeats the permission phrase four times around distinct extraordinary acts.
5:112 moves from a question about the Lord's ability to 5:116-118's deity, lordship, and servant distinctions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real acts, repeated permission, rejected deification, common lordship, and servitude; I supply the arrow that licensed agency is a mode within mulk rather than a rival to it. A live alternative is that the permission refrain authenticates only these miracles and should not be generalized into an agency model.

changed_reading.before: Universal divine power competes with creaturely action, so one must cancel the other.
changed_reading.after: God's universal mulk and qadir can contain effective creaturely action precisely as delegated, permission-bound agency, while excluding autonomous divinity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jesus's witness is explicitly duration-bound; after his taking, God remains the watcher, and the ayah ends with God over every thing as witness. The next ayah preserves the same universal over-every-thing construction but changes the predicate to qadir. Capacity therefore becomes the executive complement of uninterrupted witness: nothing seen and attested lies beyond disposition.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the jurisdiction that can act on universally witnessed reality.
Effective capacity supplies the executive predicate paired with the preceding universal witness.
Presence with observation contrasts a witness limited by residence with God's universal witnessing.
Taking the soul marks the point at which finite human oversight ends.
Continuing watch after the witness's removal prevents any lapse in oversight.
The same encompassing totality sets up the exact scope inherited by qadir.
The same every-reportable-thing object makes the witness and capacity clauses directly commensurable.

structural_cues: 5:117 moves from a witness present only while among a people to God as watcher after his removal.
The adjacent endings place witness and qadir in the same construction over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite witness, enduring divine watch, and an exact adjacent syntactic parallel; I supply the arrow from universal witnessing to capacity as its executive completion. A live alternative is that the two predicates accumulate praise without a functional knowledge-to-action relation.

changed_reading.before: Qadir is an abstract assertion of ability appended after a judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: Qadir assures that universal divine witnessing never remains merely observational: every witnessed thing remains within effective sovereign disposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, punishment and forgiveness concern owned servants under the names mighty and wise; then truth becomes beneficial, reward persists, and satisfaction is reciprocal. The final mulk/qadir formula can therefore ratify not normless force but the capacity to realize and sustain a wise relational verdict.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal connect the servants' fate to the final dominion claim.
Effective capacity guarantees that the preceding verdict and reward can be made actual.
Owned servants keep punishment and forgiveness inside the sovereign relation rather than outside it.
Prevailing might supplies the ability to carry either disposition through.
Rightly placed wisdom qualifies the force that the closing qadir predicate could otherwise leave abstract.
Benefit rather than harm identifies the realized consequence of truth.
Truth fulfilled in word and act supplies the criterion whose consequence is implemented.
Stable persistence shows that power must sustain the awarded state, not merely initiate it.
Reciprocal satisfaction makes the settlement relational rather than purely coercive.
Attained good and deliverance name the completed outcome ratified by final capacity.

structural_cues: 5:118 places the servants' punishment or forgiveness under paired might and wisdom.
5:119 moves from truth's benefit to lasting reward and reciprocal satisfaction immediately before the dominion formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, might qualified by wisdom, beneficial truth, persistence, and mutual satisfaction; I infer that mulk/qadir guarantees implementation and continuance of that settlement. A live alternative is that 5:120 is only a generic doxological seal and does not inherit these ethical qualifications.

changed_reading.before: Universal power is sheer capacity whose quality remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Universal power is shown capable of judging owned servants wisely and of bringing a truthful, beneficial, mutually accepted settlement into enduring reality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the sustaining-water branch of mulk and cooking-vessel branch of qadr are distant from the surface senses in 5:120. It remains anchored to those focus roots and is activated by the table's descent, benefit, and apportioned provision; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a translation or preferred interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mulk, the heavens/earth axis, and qadir, especially their resource, upper-source, fertile-recipient, and vessel images.

activation_trace.role: Water by which a traveling group controls its affairs supplies a material image of dominion as sustaining resource.
The upper cover that includes cloud and rain supplies the source-domain for descending provision.
Fertile receiving earth supplies the lower domain in which provision becomes usable life.
The cooking vessel supplies a deliberately material image for capacity that prepares and portions provision.
The food tray makes the requested sign a concrete table rather than an abstract proof.
Delivery downward supplies the transfer from upper owned domain to lower recipients.
Feeding, benefit, and gift turn the table into an act of sustaining distribution.
Apportioned giving supplies the allocation operation within the provisioning analogy.

changed_reading.before: Dominion is static title and qadir is abstract ability.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, dominion is also the provisioning economy that can lower, prepare, and apportion sustaining resources from the upper domain into the lower community.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the road-or-valley branch of mulk is form-distant and the directional circuit is reader-supplied. It remains anchored to the focus ayah's upper/lower/within domain and to explicit contextual descent, return, gathering, and flow; downstream prose should label it a spatial systems analogy rather than a lexical sense of mulk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mulk together with the heavens, earth, what lies within them, and qadir as effective command over movement through that domain.

activation_trace.role: The center or course of a road and valley images dominion as a routed field rather than a static container.
The upper realm supplies one pole of the routed domain.
The lower realm supplies the receiving and traversed pole.
Effective command keeps every movement in the circuit within one capacity.
Return to what one came from supplies the upward or homeward leg of the circuit.
Gathering dispersed agents supplies convergence at the domain's accountable center.
Descent from above supplies the downward leg into the inhabited field.
Continuous flow supplies movement within the finally stabilized domain.

changed_reading.before: The heavens, earth, and their contents form a static inventory of possessions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form one governed circuit in which gifts descend, agents traverse and return, the dispersed are gathered, and life-giving flow continues.

strongest_changes: The compensation sequences made qadir readable as calibrated disposition as well as unbounded ability.
The close 5:97 lexical echo made mulk readable as the mainstay that converts total knowledge into maintained order.
The fourfold permission around Jesus's acts made universal ownership a framework for delegated agency while blocking autonomous divinity.
The adjacent universal-witness and universal-capacity clauses joined uninterrupted oversight to executable sovereign power.
The servant, wisdom, truth, reward, and satisfaction sequence qualified power as able to sustain a wise settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activators were two near-formal bridges: 5:97 repeats the cosmic scope after qiyam and knowledge, while 5:117 repeats over every thing immediately with witness. The permission/servant chain then made the final ownership claim relational, and the descending table kept a branch-distant material provisioning model alive.
remaining_uncertainties: The qiyam/mainstay link may be a deliberate scaling mechanism, or the cosmic repetition may be formulaic.
Legal proportionality and wise verdict may characterize exercises of qadir without entering the word's final predicate directly.
The provisioning and routed-domain outliers depend on form-distant branch images and should remain explicitly analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The closing dominion gathers every differentiated domain.** `م ل ك B001` is strength/cohesion, `س م و B004` overhead sky/cover, `ء ر ض B001` lower ground, `ك ل ل B003` totality, and `ق د ر B003` effective capacity. The vertical pair and all within them close the surah. I infer that the many bounded jurisdictions, habitats, communities, and testimonies remain coherent because one capacity spans them without erasing their distinctions.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remained to produce a retrospective surprise.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Comprehensive dominion absorbs every delegated act and disputed attribution.** Fixed **م ل ك / B003** (“kingship and dominion”) gathers heavens, earth, and all within them, while **B002** (“ownership and disposal”) sharpens the closing power claim. 5:115–5:119 moved through sent provision, the audit of Jesus, bounded messenger-witness, servant status, and verified truth. I infer that the final sentence resolves those relations by locating signs, messengers, recipients, judgment, and outcome inside one ownership rather than competing powers. The surah closes as a jurisdictional totalization of the local audit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists within the clipped surah window, so no later retrospective surprise emerged.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: اقتدرت الشيء جعلته قدرا؛ قدرت الشيء أي هيأته (ayn)؛ فاقدروا له أي أتموا ثلاثين؛ تقدر له الشيء أي تهيأ (sihah)؛ التروية والتفكير في تسوية أمر وتهيئته؛ نظرت فيه ودبرته وقايسته؛ قدر في السرد أي أحكمه (tahdhib)؛ التقدير من الإنسان التفكر في الأمر؛ فكر وقدر؛ قدر في السرد أي أحكمه (mufradat)

branches.branch_image_ar: موافقة الشيء لقدره ووقوعه في حد وسط
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مجيء الشيء على قدره، والوسط من الطول أو السرج والرحل، والهيئة المقدورة مثل الأقدر القصير أو الفرس الذي تقع رجلاه مواقع يديه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi pişirme kabını merkez alır; kapta pişmiş et veya yemek, pişmiş çorba suyu, kapta pişirme eylemi ve kesip pişiren görevli bu merkeze bağlı ayrı türevlerdir. Dal korunabilir, ancak bunlar tek bir nesne tanımı gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kap adı ile pişmiş ürün, pişirme eylemi, çorba suyu söz öbeği ve görevli adı ayrı facetlerde tutulur; türev anlamlar kap adına yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Et veya yemek pişirmeye yarayan kabı ve bu kaba bağlı söz ailesini kapsar: kapta pişmiş yemek, pişmiş çorba suyu, kapta pişirme eylemi ve hayvanı kesip yemeği pişiren görevli bu ailede ayrı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Et veya yemek pişirmeye yarayan kabı bildirir.
Kapta pişirilmiş et veya yemeği sonuç ürünü olarak bildirir.
Belirli söz öbeğinde pişmiş çorba suyunu bildirir.
Bir topluluğun bu kapta yemek pişirmesi eylemini bildirir.
Hayvanı kesme ve ardından eti pişirme işini üstlenen kasap veya aşçıyı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar pişirme kabını ortak merkez yapar; kapta pişen et veya yemek, pişmiş çorba suyu, kapta pişirme ve kesip pişiren görevli bu merkeze bağlı türemiş kullanımlardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malzemesi belirtilmeyen pişirme kabı yanında pişmiş ürün, pişirme eylemi ve görevli türevlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle taştan yapılmış pişirme kaplarını ve bunları yapan ya da yontan kişiyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel pişirme kabı ve taş kap
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yemek pişirmeye yarayan bir kabı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kabın malzemesini sınırlamaz ve ona bağlı yemek ile görevli türevlerini taşır; komşu dal taş kap ve onun yapımcısı çevresinde özelleşir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kapla birlikte pişmiş yemek, pişirme eylemi ve kesip pişiren görevli sözlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayaklı veya kurulmuş oluşuyla açıklanan belirli bir kazan ya da araç türünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yiyecek pişirmede kullanılan kap veya aracı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel pişirme kabı ve söz ailesidir; komşu dal kurulmuş veya ayaklı belirli bir kazan türüne odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kabın boyutunu zorunlu kılmaz ve kapla bağlantılı ürün, eylem ve görevli kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kabın özellikle çok büyük, dolgun ve toplayıcı oluşunu niteleyen bir söz öbeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da pişirme kabını adlandırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel kap ve ondan türeyen kullanımlardır; komşu dal yalnızca kabın çok büyük oluşuna bağlı özel bir nitelemedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Pişirme kabını, içinde pişen ürünü ve pişirme işiyle ilgili kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kaptaki çorba suyunu kepçeyle alma ve dipte kalanı güçlükle çıkarma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı pişirme ve servis etme ortamında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kap ile ona bağlı ürün ve görevli adlarıdır; komşu dal bu kaptaki sıvıyı dışarı alma eylemidir ve ortak bir anlam çekirdeği yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kabın kendisini ve onunla kurulan pişirme söz ailesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kabı eğip ters çevirerek içindekileri dökme veya boşaltma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da aynı tür kap ve onun içindeki yemek senaryosu bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kabı ve pişirmeyle bağlantılı adları kapsar; komşu dal kabın çevrilip içeriğinin dökülmesi eylemidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القدر إناء الطبخ، والقدير أو المرق المقدور ما طبخ فيها، والقدار الجزار أو الطباخ الذي يلي النحر والطبخ.
branches.source_phrase_ar: القدر وهي معروفة؛ القدير اللحم يطبخ في القدر؛ القدار الجزار ويقال الطباخ (maqayis)؛ القدير ما طبخ من اللحم؛ مرق مقدور؛ القدار الطباخ (ayn)؛ القدير المطبوخ في القدر؛ القدار الجزار ويقال الطباخ (sihah)؛ القدر مؤنثة؛ قدرت القدر إذا طبخت قدرا؛ القدار الجزار (tahdhib)؛ القدر اسم لما يطبخ فيه اللحم؛ قدرت اللحم طبخته؛ القدار الذي ينحر ويقدر (mufradat)
